welcome.title: Meet Nebulis
welcome.body: A quick tour of your observatory: the library, your telescope, planning a night, and your finished images. A few minutes.
welcome.hint: Start the tour when you are ready. You can leave and restart anytime from Help.

library.title: Your library, front and center
library.body: This is home base. Every object you have imaged lives here as a card with its best picture, the number of nights you captured it, and the telescope it came from.
library.hint: Search, the Filters and View buttons, and the Layout control (grid or Mosaic) help you find anything in seconds.

telescopes.title: Point it at your telescope
telescopes.body: This is the Telescopes tab. Click 'Add smart telescope', pick your model, and enter its address. The share name and defaults fill in on their own.
telescopes.hint: You do not need to import right away, but this step unlocks automatic nightly imports.

sync.title: Sync your telescope
sync.body: Once a telescope is set up, open this pill in the top bar and hit Sync. It copies new sessions over Wi-Fi (or USB) and files them into your library automatically.
sync.hint: Auto-import is on by default for each telescope you add, so new sessions usually show up on their own.

planner.title: Plan the night before it starts
planner.body: The Planner answers 'is tonight worth going out?' and then lets you schedule what to shoot when. Pick a night, drag targets into the timeline, or let Plan my night fill it using the hourly forecast.
planner.hint: Green means fully visible, amber partly visible, and red blocked by your own sky or the Moon.

processed.title: Your finished images
processed.body: This is where your finished work lands. Open any object and its page gathers every picture of it, with your processed images shown large at the top, then tabs for sub-frames, nights and projects.
processed.hint: Open a night to upload a processed image, and star any of them to make it the object's cover picture in the library.

explore.title: Discover what to shoot next
explore.body: Explore finds your next target. Search any name or catalog number, or browse by kind. Each object says whether you can see it from your site tonight and whether it fits your telescope's frame.
explore.hint: Add anything you like to your wishlist, or plan it for tonight in one tap.

catalogs.title: Track your progress
catalogs.body: Catalogs is the observing atlas: Messier, NGC, IC, Sharpless and Caldwell, each with a progress board of what you have imaged and what is left. Open a board, tap an object for its details, or open My Catalog for a wall of your own pictures.

gallery.title: Show it off
gallery.body: The Gallery turns your processed images into a full-screen slideshow you can run on a TV. Open it and press play for a clean, automatic show of your best work.

observations.title: Every night, on a calendar
observations.body: Observations is your log. It shows each session by date with the object, telescope, and whether it has a finished image, plus a world map of where you have set up.

settings.title: Make it yours
settings.body: Settings is deeper than the telescope page: observing sites, storage location, library options, alerts, connected phones and TVs, and a full system log. The search box at the top finds any setting by name.

done.title: You are ready
done.body: That is the whole loop: connect one telescope, let the imports run, find a target in Explore, plan clear nights in the Planner, and enjoy the finished images in the Gallery.
done.hint: Lost later? The Help page has written guides with screenshots, and this tour is always one click away.
